name: Stauer Lastminute
personality: Can move a mountain of cargo while being paid for a modest hill.
visual_intent: broad low square splat in weathered brown flatcap and short neckerchief, thick rope coil and small blunt cargo hook at flank; fierce crooked internal upper-tooth grin, one eyebrow lifted
biography: Can move a mountain of cargo while being paid for a modest hill. He sorts HyperNorm cargo into useful and awaiting an approved use. A dissonant card is heavier than its paperwork and lighter than his worries. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Mehrarbeit wurde auf die Last umgelegt.

name: Nieterin Nachklang
personality: Knows which noises are work and which are management.
visual_intent: tall pear blob, tied indigo headscarf with subtle lashes, compact hand-rivet hammer and little plate with THREE modeled rivet heads; tightly pursed toothless sideways mouth, unequal weary lids
biography: Knows which noises are work and which are management. Her hammer fixes HyperNorm plates into one official shape. A dissonant card rings differently at each rivet and she secretly listens for the tune. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Nachhall ist keine bezahlte Tätigkeit.

name: Kranwart Pendelzeit
personality: Has never seen time move as slowly as a suspended load.
visual_intent: round top-heavy splat, dark flatcap and tiny leather shoulder pad, single short pulley block held clearly separate from coiled rope; enormous ivory eyes looking sideways in opposite directions, tiny open triangular toothless mouth
biography: Has never seen time move as slowly as a suspended load. His pulley lifts HyperNorm loads only after the waiting has been authorized. A dissonant card notes that gravity has not completed the form. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Last hängt. Die Zeit ebenfalls.

name: Heizer Kohlenherz
personality: Feeds a machine that has never once asked how he is doing.
visual_intent: heavy drooping blob with small charcoal newsboy cap, short canvas apron patch below mouth, small coal shovel with THREE chunky clay coal pieces; lopsided heavy lids, deep sad toothless pout
biography: Feeds a machine that has never once asked how he is doing. He feeds the HyperNorm boiler with fuel marked necessary or insufficient. A dissonant card asks why the machine gets more rest than its keeper. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Maschine wurde versorgt. Der Mensch wird nachgereicht.

name: Dreher Rundlauf
personality: Finds comfort in the rare object that agrees to fit.
visual_intent: lean hooked ink splat with little canvas cap and goggles above eyes, chunky calipers surrounding ONE short machined metal cylinder; bright delighted unequal eyes, open asymmetrical smile with two upper teeth
biography: Finds comfort in the rare object that agrees to fit. His calipers admit HyperNorm parts only if they fit the prescribed gap. A dissonant card changes the gap instead of the part. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Passung entspricht vorübergehend der Wirklichkeit.

name: Weberin Fadenhalt
personality: Keeps the thread when the whole shift loses the plot.
visual_intent: low wide lopsided blob, small patterned cream headscarf and two lashes, one large wooden weaving shuttle with visible thread bobbin and short folded cloth sample; startled raised brows, small nervous open mouth with one upper tooth
biography: Keeps the thread when the whole shift loses the plot. Her shuttle weaves HyperNorm cloth in black or white. A dissonant card catches the thread between them and produces something surprisingly warm. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Faden hält. Der Schichtplan weniger.
